text: {"lessons":["Selling my early gains did not protect the account from later losses; I should base each trade on a consistent plan, not the comfort of locking in a small profit.","After buying again, I made no trades through a substantial decline. I should reassess each holding against my risk limits and portfolio goals instead of letting reluctance to admit a mistake keep me invested.","Short-term swings, including the rebound in the last period, are not reliable signals in a random market. I should avoid reacting to noise and make deliberate portfolio-wide decisions."]}
